notes.title: Major update Ver.1.1.1.1 (Please play with a New Game)
notes.content:
[b]●Update contents[/b]

・Significant adjustments to game design to shorten the basic gameplay cycle to 3-4 hours
・Removed restrictions on whether all items in the game can be investigated
　┗More freedom in exploration is now possible
・Changes to iron bar and salt specifications
　┗Multiple items can be placed on the map and replaced at any time for use
・Text improvements
　┗Text related to hints will now be highlighted
・Changes to interaction operation specifications
　┗All interactions can now be performed by clicking or pressing a button
・Improvements to improve performance
・Other adjustments and data additions
